items.html: For the liver sends from its outer aspect the Nefesh of the Nefesh to the Netzach, Hod, Yesod of the outer aspect. And the Ruach of the Nefesh it sends from its middle aspect to the ChGT of the outer aspect, and from its inner aspect it sends the Neshama to the KHB of the Nefesh of the outer aspect. And afterwards, the heart sends the Nefesh of the Ruach to the NHY of the middles, and the Ruach of the Ruach to the ChGT of the middles, and from its inner aspect it sends the Neshama of the Ruach to the KHB of the middles. And afterwards, the brain sends from its outer aspect the Nefesh of the Neshama to the NHY of the inner aspect, and from its middle aspect it sends the Ruach of the Neshama to the ChGT of the inner aspect, and from its inner aspect it sends the Neshama of the Neshama to the KHB of the inner aspect.
